Name: Mekonah
ModernLocation: Unknown; in Judah after the return from exile
Description: Mekonah was a town in Judah resettled after the exile, named in Nehemiah's list of dwellers (Nehemiah 11). No further story is attached to it in Scripture, and its exact site is unidentified.
BiblicalSignificance: Its inclusion in Nehemiah's list marks it as one of the towns inhabited after the return from exile.
